nodes.label: Triage label map
nodes.rationale: Skills speak in five canonical triage roles. This file maps each role onto the same label string in the tracker so agents use needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, and wontfix rather than a second vocabulary.

nodes.label: Canonical triage roles
nodes.rationale: needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, and wontfix keep the same spelling in mattpocock/skills and in this tracker. ready-for-agent means fully specified for an AFK agent; ready-for-human means a person must implement it.
